newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss 3-month money market claims yield 1.210 pct.
newsitem.headline: Swiss 3-month money market claims yield 1.210 pct.

text.p: The annual yield on the latest issue of Swiss federal government three-month money market claims is 1.210 percent, down from the previous issue's 1.282 percent, the Swiss National Bank said.
The latest issue, to be paid for on July 17, raised 791.9 million Swiss francs and was priced at 99.695 percent.
The previous issue, paid for on July 10, raised 978.05 million and was priced at 99.677 percent. -- Zurich Editorial +41 1 631 7340
